items.criterion: speclang history in a fresh git repo with no commits prints no GitError stack trace; docs/API_REFERENCE.md documents that codegen target comes from getTarget()
items.detail: (a) Fresh-repo path: in /tmp/freshrepo (git init, zero commits) `node /home/kara/speclang/bin/speclang history` printed 'No commits yet — this repository has no history to show.' + 'git add -A && git commit -m "initial commit"' with EXIT=0 and no GitError/stack; the same held for --format json ([]), --stat, --stat --format json (zeroed object), --blame, --format timeline, --compare a..b, --all, --block @x. Guard lives in bin/speclang:2500-2520 (detectEmptyHistory at bin/speclang:57-80, emptyHistoryMessage at :82-104) and runs before any git plumbing. Tests: `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/cli/history.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 18 passed (18)', including 'prints a graceful, actionable message instead of a GitError' which asserts output not.toContain('GitError') and no stack-trace regex; `npx vitest run tests/cli/` -> 8 files / 51 tests passed. (b) Docs: docs/API_REFERENCE.md is a symlink to specs/docs.spec.dir/docs/API_REFERENCE.md (readlink -f confirms), so the committed edit is the named file; new section at docs/API_REFERENCE.md:44-68 documents getTarget()/getAllTargets() and states 'codegen() takes the target ID (a string), not the object from getTarget()'. Claims match code: src/compiler/targets/index.ts:121 (case-insensitive, returns undefined) and src/compiler/phases/codegen.ts:10-14 (codegen(ir, targetId: string) -> getTarget -> throws 'Unknown target: <id>'); runtime check via dist/index.js reproduced every documented value (getTarget('typescript').id='compiler/ts-target', getTarget('TYPESCRIPT')===getTarget('typescript') true, getTarget('cobol') undefined, codegen(ir,'cobol') throws 'Unknown target: cobol'). [resolution 0.13; docs/API_REFERENCE.md]

items.criterion: The empty-history guard is reachable from the real CLI entrypoint (bin/speclang `history` action) and covers every mode (default log, --format json/timeline, --stat, --blame, --compare, --all, --block) — no mode still reaches git plumbing that throws GitError
items.detail: bin/speclang:2500 `const emptyHistory = await detectEmptyHistory(git)` runs first in the `history` action; per-mode branches at :2527 (--compare), :2565 (--stat), :2610 (--blame), :2695 (timeline), :2714 (default). Manually executed all nine invocations in /tmp/freshrepo: every one exited 0 with the guidance message and no GitError/stack.

items.criterion: The guard does not regress the non-empty path: a repo WITH commits (incl. a bare repo) still prints real history and is not mislabelled 'not a git repository'
items.detail: /tmp/withcommits (1 commit): default -> '44b447f  2026-11-17  T  spec: seed core' + '1 commits' exit 0; --format json -> the commit object; --stat -> 'Total commits: 1'. Bare-repo case covered by the passing test 'still reads history from a BARE repository (not mislabelled as no-repo)' (18/18 passed) and by the `--git-dir` probe choice at bin/speclang:57-62.

items.criterion: The documented getTarget()/codegen contract matches the shipped code (case-insensitive lookup, undefined for unknown, codegen takes the target id string and throws 'Unknown target: <id>')
items.detail: src/compiler/targets/index.ts:121-123 `getTarget(lang){ return targets[lang.toLowerCase()]; }`; src/compiler/phases/codegen.ts:10-14 `codegen(ir, targetId: string)` -> getTarget -> `throw new Error('Unknown target: ' + targetId)`. Runtime via dist/index.js: upper===lower true, 'cobol' -> undefined, codegen(ir,'cobol') -> 'Unknown target: cobol'. dist/index.d.ts:23 and dist/src/compiler/targets/index.d.ts:43 export the same signature.
